name: MapCompareLayout
intent: A side-by-side map comparison workspace: two geo-aligned map surfaces (as-planned / as-built) inside a single pannable, zoomable CompareView, with a vertical MapToolbar (compare modes, locate, zoom, compass), an overview minimap, a per-view TimestampPicker to scrub each side's capture, an optional session TimelineRangeSelector docked at the bottom to drive both dates, and a fullscreen toggle. The full-page realization of the map-compare workspace, authored from the MapCompareLayout widget.
when: Compare two captures of the same site over time (as-planned vs as-built, before/after)
The user needs to pan/zoom a map and swipe or split between two geo-aligned sources
Scrub each side to a specific capture (per-view timestamp) or drive both from a shared timeline
Start here instead of wiring CompareView + MapToolbar + minimap + pickers by hand
whenNot: A single project's KPIs + list + map overview -> use the CoreOrgOverview product route or compose the dashboard-page pattern
A read-only single map with markers and no compare -> compose the Map widget + MapControls directly
A master-detail worklist of items -> use the TaskMonitor template
A whole-page error / empty state -> use ErrorPage / Empty

chooseOver.over: Composing CompareView + MapToolbar + MapMinimap + TimestampPicker by hand
chooseOver.because: The MapWorkspace template owns the region layout (compare surface / toolbar / minimap / per-view pickers / session timeline) and the date state flowing between the two views.

regions.role: Two geo-aligned map sources (as-planned / as-built) in one pannable, zoomable compare view with swipe/split modes
regions.source: MapCompareLayout widget (@core/core-ui/map-compare-layout) — map + compareMap slots wrapping a CompareView

regions.role: Vertical map toolbar: compare modes (split/swipe), locate, zoom, and a compass reset, top-right
A TimestampPicker centered over each view (shown only while comparing) to scrub that side's capture date
regions.source: TimestampPicker (@core/core-ui/timestamp-picker) in the mapCenter / compareMapCenter slots

regions.role: Overview minimap that tracks and drives the current viewport, bottom-right
regions.note: On by default; a second overview appears bottom-left in unlocked side-by-side compare.

regions.role: A bottom-docked TimelineRangeSelector (shown only while comparing) whose two handles scrub the compared dates, kept in sync with the per-view pickers

requiredWidgets.name: MapCompareLayout
requiredWidgets.note: The compare workspace widget: CompareView + MapToolbar + MapMinimap in one layout.

requiredWidgets.name: TimestampPicker
requiredWidgets.note: Per-view capture scrubber floated over each source while comparing.

optionalWidgets.name: TimelineRangeSelector
optionalWidgets.note: Session timeline docked in the bottom bar; drives both compared dates (opt-in via withSessionTimeline).

withSessionTimeline.note: Dock the session TimelineRangeSelector in the bottom bar to scrub both compared dates.

className.note: Forwarded to the compare workspace when not fullscreen.

dataContract.note: Config only. The capture entries and the two compared dates are owned internally today (see dataSources) — a production MapWorkspace should lift captures + selection to props.

dataSources.note: MOCK fixture today (~100 days of captures generated from a fixed anchor for stable snapshots). Production use must supply real capture sessions (no prop to inject them yet).

dataFlow: captures -> the per-view TimestampPickers (mapCenter / compareMapCenter) and the session timeline dots
planned (left / later) + built (right / earlier) dates -> which capture each view shows
scrub a per-view picker -> updates that side's date -> its view
drag the session timeline handles -> latestCaptureOnDay(start/end) -> both dates, in sync with the pickers
toggle fullscreen -> the workspace fills the viewport with an exit button

states.default: Two geo-aligned scenes with a fullscreen toggle; per-view pickers and the session timeline surface once a compare mode is active.
states.comparing: A compare mode (split / swipe) is active -> the two per-view TimestampPickers and (if enabled) the bottom session timeline appear.
states.session-timeline: withSessionTimeline docks a TimelineRangeSelector in the bottom bar; its handles scrub both compared dates, staying in sync with the pickers.
states.fullscreen: The workspace fills the viewport (fixed inset) with a floating Exit button.
states.single-map: Omit the compareMap for a plain pan/zoom map — the toolbar drops the split control; the minimap still tracks the view (widget-level capability).

responsive.strategy: Fluid full-height compare surface; floating toolbar (top-right), minimap (bottom-right), per-view pickers (top-center), and an optional docked session timeline (bottom).
responsive.note: The workspace fills its container; fullscreen expands it to the viewport. Controls float over the map rather than reflowing it.

forbiddenPlacement: nested in another scroll container (it manages its own compare surface + minimap sizing)

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-wiring CompareView + MapToolbar + MapMinimap + pickers by hand
commonMistakes.symptom: Compare-mode, viewport, and picker plumbing are duplicated per page
commonMistakes.fix: Use the MapCompareLayout widget (this template owns the composition).

commonMistakes.symptom: The workspace shows synthetic captures in production
commonMistakes.fix: Supply real capture sessions (a production MapWorkspace needs a captures prop when widgetized).

commonMistakes.mistake: Placing the workspace inside another scroll container
commonMistakes.symptom: The compare surface and minimap mis-size and double scrollbars appear
commonMistakes.fix: Give it a full content region (CoreContentArea).

evaluationCriteria.check: MapWorkspace chosen for a two-source map comparison — not a Dashboard (KPIs + list + map) or a plain single Map.
compare-surface + toolbar render; per-view pickers and the session timeline appear on compare; minimap tracks the view.
withSessionTimeline toggles the docked session timeline; the two compared dates stay in sync across pickers and timeline.
The MapCompareLayout widget is composed rather than re-assembled from CompareView + MapToolbar + minimap.
Produces the map-compare workspace markup with both sources and floating controls.
